statement.p: Consider the ordered bases B=(\left[\begin{array}{cc} 1 \amp 0\cr 0 \amp -1 \end{array}\right],\left[\begin{array}{cc} 0 \amp 0\cr 2 \amp 0 \end{array}\right]) and C=(\left[\begin{array}{cc} 3 \amp 0\cr 1 \amp -3 \end{array}\right],\left[\begin{array}{cc} 2 \amp 0\cr 1 \amp -2 \end{array}\right]) for the vector space V of lower triangular 2\times 2 matrices with zero trace.
a. Find the transition matrix from C to B.
b. Find the coordinates of M in the ordered basis B if the coordinate vector of M in C is [M]_C = \left[\begin{array}{c} 3\cr -3 \end{array}\right].
